language.name: English
join.name_note: Shown next to the songs you add. No account needed.
join.step_scan: Scan the code with your phone camera, or type the address above.
join.step_name: Type your name. No account needed.
join.step_sign_in: Sign in. No account yet? Ask the host for one.
join.step_request: Search for a song or browse the library, then tap it to add it to the party queue.
join.order_note: Requests play in order. When the queue is empty, the party mix keeps going.
join.android_note: Android: if Chrome won't open the page, allow Chrome's Nearby devices permission in the phone's settings.
queue.title: Queue
queue.empty: No requests yet. When the queue is empty, songs come from the auto pool.

queue.yours.one: , {n} from you (tap × to take yours back)
queue.yours.other: , {n} from you (tap × to take yours back)

queue.ask_too_before: Want a song that's already here? Tap
queue.ask_too_after: to ask for it too: it moves up a place and uses one of your requests.
playing.skip_resting: You can vote to skip again after this song
playing.nothing_hint: Find a song and add it to the queue.
playing.no_requests: No requests yet. Yours could be next.
playing.scan_hint: Scan with your phone, then choose from the library.
search.placeholder: Search, or describe: 80s rock, chill house...
search.nothing_fits: Nothing in the library fits that.
wish.title: Ask for a song
wish.asked: Asked. The admin will see it.
language.label: Language
menu.sound_permission: Saving a sound needs permission to write to storage.
menu.saved_alarm: Saved as an alarm sound. Choose it in Clock or your phone's sound settings.
menu.saved_ringtone: Saved as a ringtone. Choose it in your phone's sound settings.
menu.saved_notification: Saved as a notification sound. Choose it in your phone's sound settings.
menu.report_thanks: Thanks, the admin will take a look.
menu.no_playlists: No playlists here yet. Make one under Library > Lists.
menu.added_offline: Added to {name}. It reaches the server when you're back online.
report.wrong_info: The title, artist or album is wrong
report.sounds_bad: It sounds bad, skips or cuts off
signin.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check the address and that this phone is on the right network.
signin.not_qr_server: That isn't the server the QR code is for: its certificate is different. Someone on this network may be in the way.
signin.not_announced_server: That server isn't what it announced: its certificate is different. Someone on this network may be in the way.
signin.bad_address: That doesn't look like a server address.
signin.nearby_note: Android may ask about nearby devices: that's how it lets an app find and reach a computer on your network.
signin.recognize_note: Anyone on a network can give a computer any name, so only sign in to a server you recognize.
signin.none_heard: No servers heard yet. GO has to be on, on a computer on this network, and some networks block this. You can still scan or enter the address below.
signin.connect_help: Scan the QR code from GO on a computer (Account > Open on your phone), or enter the address Admin > GO shows, like 192.168.1.20:8067.
signin.camera_needed: Scanning needs the camera. You can type the address instead.
signin.unencrypted_home: This server isn't offering encryption, so others on this network could see your password and what you play. Its admin can turn it on under Admin > GO.
signin.unencrypted_away: {address} is outside your home network and isn't offering encryption. Your password and music would cross the internet where others could read them.
signin.cert_changed_body: {name} is presenting a different certificate from last time. That happens if it was set up again, but it's also what someone in the middle would look like. Check that Admin > GO shows this code: {code}
signin.remove_body: This forgets the server and deletes the songs and system sounds kept on this phone for it.
signin.nonsense: The server's answer made no sense. Is it up to date?
signin.two_step_help: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
signin.encrypted_code: Encrypted. Security code {code}, which Admin > GO shows too.
signin.not_encrypted_note: Not encrypted: others on this network could see your password.
settings.full_quality: Full quality: keep the original files
settings.sign_out_keeps: The songs kept on this phone from this server stay here, locked until you sign back in.
settings.sign_out_deletes: The songs and system sounds kept on this phone from this server will be deleted. Those from other servers stay. You can download them again after signing back in.
settings.title: Settings
settings.not_encrypted: Not encrypted: others on this network could see what's sent. The server's admin can turn encryption on.
settings.elsewhere: This phone also keeps {songs} for other servers or accounts, {size}. They're left alone while you're here.
settings.ask_updates: Ask when there's a new version
settings.quality_note: FLAC and WAV songs can be converted, on your server, to take less room. Other formats stay as they are. Applies to songs fetched from now on.
settings.fetch_ahead_note: The next songs in your queue are fetched while one plays, so they carry on through a weak signal. Uses mobile data too.
settings.smart_cache_note: Keep what you play most and like, on Wi-Fi while charging.
settings.not_converting: Some lossless songs are at full size: your server isn't converting for this account. Admin > GO can turn converting on.
settings.remove_all: Remove all kept songs and sounds
settings.saved_sounds_note: A song's menu can save it as an alarm, ringtone or notification sound.
settings.no_downloads: Your role doesn't include keeping songs on this phone. Ask your host for the download permission.
settings.update_available: Version {version} is available from this server.
settings.tap_end: Add it to the end of the queue
settings.not_changed: Couldn't reach the server, so that wasn't changed.
settings.talk_over: When another app needs to talk
settings.talk_over_note: Such as an assistant screening a call, or directions. A call you answer always pauses the music.
settings.visuals_note: The sparkle button on Now Playing switches between the cover and these. Fancier styles use more battery.
settings.auto_styles_note: In full screen, a new style every 30 seconds.
settings.timing_note: If visuals seem to come before the sound, raise this; if after, lower it.
download.not_converting: Your server isn't converting songs for this account, so these stay at full size: {size}.
download.up_to: Up to {size}. FLAC and WAV songs will take less once converted, but converting takes the server a while.
go.liked_empty: Tap the heart on a song, album or artist to keep it here.
go.history_empty: Songs you play show up here.

kept.locked_away.one: Your {n} kept song is locked because this phone hasn't reached the server for a while. It will unlock when it does.
kept.locked_away.other: Your {n} kept songs are locked because this phone hasn't reached the server for a while. They'll unlock when it does.

kept.nothing: Nothing here yet. A song's menu can download it, and albums have a download button.

kept.locked_elsewhere.one: {n} song is locked until you sign in to its server, or that server is reached again.
kept.locked_elsewhere.other: {n} songs are locked until you sign in to their server, or that server is reached again.

playlist.import_note: This brings in the list, not the music. Songs you don't have stay in the list, flagged, and are skipped. For other services, get a file from Tune My Music or Soundiiz.
playlist.youtube_on: You can paste a YouTube playlist link too.
playlist.youtube_off: YouTube links are off on this server. An admin can turn them on under Admin > Library.
playlist.paste_or_link: Or paste songs, or a YouTube link
playlist.share_note: They can see and play it. Only you can change it.
playlist.name: Name
playlist.delete_note: Songs stay in the library and on this phone.

genres.shuffled.one: {n} song, shuffled with the most played nearer the top.
genres.shuffled.other: {n} songs, shuffled with the most played nearer the top.

year.title: Your {year}
year.nothing: Nothing played on DJINN GO in {year} yet.
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR code. In GO on a computer: Account > Open on your phone.

genres.top_of.one: Top {shown} of {n} genre. Tap one to see what's near it.
genres.top_of.other: Top {shown} of {n} genres. Tap one to see what's near it.

genres.cloud_description: Genres and how they relate. The list view has the same genres.
visual.moves_note: It moves while a song plays.

visual.too_slow.one: Left out as too slow here: {n}. Try it again
visual.too_slow.other: Left out as too slow here: {n}. Try them again

visual.rotate_every.one: All the way around every {n} second
visual.rotate_every.other: All the way around every {n} seconds

download.smart: Keeping your favorites on this phone
cast.other_server: That song is kept from another server, so it can't be cast from here.
cast.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server to start casting.
player.too_many_streams: You're already listening on as many devices as your role allows.
update.mismatch: The download didn't match what the server said it was sending.
mood.title: Mood
mood.your_setting: Your mood setting, chill to hype
eq.title: Equalizer
eq.yours_note: Shape the sound for your own listening on this device. On iPhones and iPads, music may stop when the screen locks while the equalizer is on.
eq.phone_note: Shape the sound for your own listening on this phone. It doesn't change what the party hears.
eq.turn_on: Turn on to hear these settings.
